title: Tickets, reaction roles, starboard, raid mode and more
items: /ticket rebuilt with a staff role, categories, claiming, close reasons and transcripts
/reactionroles, /suggest, /starboard, /birthday, /afk and /bank added
/raidmode can switch on by itself when many people join at once
/case shows a member's history and keeps private staff notes
/warn limits, punishment and expiry are now configurable
/remind accepts 10m, 2h or 1d and can list or cancel reminders; /purge has bot, link and text filters
Extra auto-moderation: spam, mass mentions and capital letters
Fixed: /work and /rob cooldowns no longer reset when the bot restarts

title: More tools for server admins
items: Member lookup with cases, warnings and private staff notes
Insights: joins and leaves, busiest channels and popular commands
Settings for warnings, tickets, starboard, suggestions, raid mode and birthdays
Backup and restore of server settings
Test buttons for logs and the ability to delete or edit cases
Automatic removal of members who never verify

title: Honeypot, verification, logs, mod-log and confessions
items: /honeypot traps spam bots and hacked accounts and removes them automatically
/verify adds a button or small-question gate before members get a role
/logs records message, member, role, channel, voice and ban events; /modlog sets the moderation log
/confess and /confession add anonymous confessions with optional review and moderator tools

title: Blue theme and better admin dashboard
items: New colors and fonts that match the bot's logo
Admin overview with a setup checklist and a bot permission check
Moderation case browser with filters and CSV export
Dashboard activity log and confession moderation pages
Settings pages for logs, honeypot, verification and confessions

title: New look and status tools
items: Redesigned every page for phones, tablets and desktops
Light and dark themes
Live status with 30-day uptime bars and an incident history
Planned maintenance notices
Command analytics with daily usage trends

title: Cleaner code, configurable AI chat
items: Command files reorganised and reformatted
/chat now works with any OpenAI-compatible provider (AI_API_KEY, AI_API_URL, AI_MODEL)
Command usage is recorded per day for the analytics page
